[Section] Experiments ::: Hyperparameters
[source_id=49] We used the LibSVM utility of the WEKA tool. We chose the linear kernel option to classify the reviews. We trained word2vec embeddings on all the four corpora using the Gensim library BIBREF18 with the skip-gram method. The dimension size of these embeddings are set at 200. As mentioned, other embeddings, which are generated utilising the clustering and the SVD approach, are also of size 200. For c-mean clustering, we set the maximum number of iterations at 25, unless it converges.
